data.title: Head Chef
data.summary: The role leads a small kitchen team producing restaurant lunches and catering services. It combines hands-on cooking with developing the food offering and catering business.

requirements.text: At least 3 years as a head chef or shift manager in Finland
requirements.question: Would someone who has done head chef or shift manager work, with fewer than 3 years, be worth a conversation?
requirements.why: The posting asks for prior head chef or shift manager experience for a stated minimum period.

requirements.text: Ability to independently lead a kitchen and a small team

requirements.question: What does 'passion for hands-on kitchen work' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting emphasises passion for kitchen work and being actively involved rather than working at a laptop.

requirements.text: Skill in making tasty food from scratch with fresh ingredients

requirements.question: What does 'development-focused leadership' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting names development-focused leadership as a strength without describing a concrete example.

requirements.text: Ability to inspire the team and stay enthusiastic
Broad professional expertise to develop the business and team
